newsitem.title: USA: RSI Systems Inc Q2 Dec 31 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: RSI Systems Inc Q2 Dec 31 loss widens.

text.p: RSI Systems Inc said on Thursday higher research and development costs and an inventory writedown contributed to a wider loss in the second quarter ended December 31.
The company lost $1.8 million, or $0.38 a share, compared to a loss of $994,208, or $0.31 a share, one year ago.
Sales increased to $454,215 from $369,775, RSI said.
RSI said its selling, general and administrative costs were also higher in the most recent period than a year ago.
RSI develops full-motion video and audio conferencing systems.
